none: PAS LIN-B12288: Roman silver 'ToT' finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver Roman finger ring, Henig Type VIII. The ring bezel is circular and the shoulders are triangular, tapering to a complete circular hoop. The triangular shoulders have a deep groove running around the perimeter. Down the centre is a large oval panel decorated with upward pointing hatches. Within the panel at the top is a small circle with what resembles the letter 'T' set on its side below…
